tx_publication_proposal.scope: Exact extracted C host contracts under ASan/UBSan; no router, actual DMA, weak-memory occurrence, or firmware response tested. Queue/PHY/skb structures are reduced fixtures, not actual kernel ABI/layout validation.

before.expected: negative control, baseline TX contract must fail

initial_failed_attempt.cause: 0034 malformed hunk count; corrected by patch owner before successful final run

fixture_constants_verified.limitation: Reduced host queue/PHY/skb types are not actual kernel ABI/layout validation.

tx_publication_proposal.post_review_note: Two comment-only lines added after build input pinning were removed; executed test logic is unchanged and the published test matches the pinned build input.

prepared_source_provenance.scope: Actual prepared npu.c exactly equals preserved r35 npu.c plus 0034; no fuzz.

tx_publication_object.scope: Pinned actual AArch64 object has TXWI memcpy, address store, dmb oshst, DONE composition and control store in that order. Vendor saved decoder ranges match actual blob bytes; not independent full decoding, hardware execution, weak-memory occurrence or Air causality.

safe_model.change: Do not enter the TDM consumer when its argument is zero; no firmware modification.

budget.scope: Scalar branch/budget arithmetic only. No packet/DMA/MMIO execution, concurrency or time-to-failure model.

stop_timeout.scope: Frozen descriptor/stop observations; no claim that every combination is reachable or erroneous during a coordinated hardware stop.

limitations: The full saved disassembly is not independently decoded; only listed standard branch offsets are.
Vendor custom opcodes, complete CFG, hardware ordering and concurrent actors are not modeled.
Early RX-empty, allocator/dispatch failure and hardware waits can terminate/block the scalar path first.
A 2^32 decrement count is arithmetic, not an observed uninterrupted execution.
No causal attribution to the Air sleep/wake stall; no live test was performed.

model.scope: Exact scalar ring arithmetic with legal releases; not firmware execution. Runtime reachability, aggregate ownership, concurrency, fairness, locks and MMIO are not modeled.

completion_pools.limitation: Byte correspondence is not independent instruction decoding, semantic proof, hardware testing or evidence of Air stall attribution. Unsupported custom opcodes in the saved linear decoder remain uninterpreted.

negative_controls.note: Expected failures are not candidate failures or candidate pass counts. Firmware baseline budget failures are listed separately in firmware_analysis.

limitations: No device access, configuration change, installation, reboot or additional wireless tests.
Host fixtures test exact extracted functions with substitutes, not kernel ABI, weak-memory occurrence, firmware response or hardware acceptance.
Host TX publication ordering is corrected; causality for Air intermittent sleep/wake stalls remains unproven.
Vendor zero-budget arithmetic flaw and unsafe-looking stop continuations are recorded but no binary patch is included.
Firmware byte/branch correspondence and scalar pool/budget models do not prove complete control flow, concurrency, fairness, reachable deadlock or Air causality.
Existing r35 limitations for failed link activation rollback, selector ABA and PPE binding invalidation remain.
Kernel and 73 modules match r35, which was not boot-tested either; only mt76.ko changed.
Native incremental build with pinned inputs, not clean-room reproducibility.
